correctness.rationale: Products of core reflections give exactly the translations by H=2A. Normalizing that subgroup forces the same L on each coset, and substitution in 2y−x gives precisely 2b_c=L(2r_c) for a map fixing zero, with bijectivity exactly the permutation condition on C. The map δ:C→H/2H is onto with t fibers of size u. For fixed L, the zero fiber has (u−1)! permissible bijections and the other fibers have u! each; each of the ut−1 nonzero cosets has t lifts, and b_0 is fixed. The factor |A| is for undoing the normalization. This includes the trivial group, odd order, and exponent two. The factorial factor for rank-two mixed heights is 16 versus the group-automorphism ratio 8; for two heights at least two it is 64 versus 16. The other patterns give ratio one. Hand checks reproduce 128, 768 and 6144; the uploaded verifier was read, not run.
